relations.subject: server/8.0/eventing/eventing-handler-convertAdvXMLtoJSON
relations.evidence: This function will handle items and constructs that **[convertXMLtoJSON](eventing-handler-convertXMLtoJSON.md)** will fail on 1) empty-element tags and 2) attributes.

notable_absence.finding: Pure JS code-sample page: a generic recursive XML-to-JSON parser handling attributes and empty-element tags (regex-based, with a 6.6.0/7.0.0 dual implementation), demonstrated inside an OnUpdate handler. Content is byte-identical to the Capella twin apart from front matter. The only Eventing-specific framing is the standard Function Scope/Listen to Location/Eventing Storage/Binding configuration comment block, already captured generically by eventing:function and eventing:binding - nothing new here. No disagreement with the Capella record found.
